description: If subsets agree below k and differ at k with k in S alone, the code of S exceeds that of T by at least 1/3^(k+1).
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.InfiniteCardinalArithmetic.ternaryCode_first_difference (S T : Set ℕ) (k : ℕ)
  (hbefore : ∀ n < k, n ∈ S ↔ n ∈ T) (hkS : k ∈ S) (hkT : k ∉ T) :
  1 / 3 ^ (k + 1) ≤
    Lemmatheca.Entry.InfiniteCardinalArithmetic.ternaryCode S -
      Lemmatheca.Entry.InfiniteCardinalArithmetic.ternaryCode T
